description: This file defines the AWS ElasticsearchService client class in PHP, including method annotations for various API operations provided by the Amazon Elasticsearch Service.

classes.name: ElasticsearchServiceClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon Elasticsearch Service, extending the AwsClient base to provide specific API methods.

methods.name: acceptInboundCrossClusterSearchConnection
methods.description: Accepts inbound cross-cluster search connection request.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds specified tags to an Elasticsearch domain.

methods.name: associatePackage
methods.description: Associates a package with an Elasticsearch domain.

methods.name: authorizeVpcEndpointAccess
methods.description: Provides access to a VPC endpoint for Elasticsearch.

methods.name: deleteElasticsearchServiceRole
methods.description: Deletes the role used by Elasticsearch service.

methods.name: describeDomainAutoTunes
methods.description: Describes auto-tune settings for a domain.

methods.name: describeDomainChangeProgress
methods.description: Describes progress of a domain change.

methods.name: describeElasticsearchDomainConfig
methods.description: Describes the configuration of an Elasticsearch domain.

methods.name: describeElasticsearchInstanceTypeLimits
methods.description: Describes limits for Elasticsearch instance types.

methods.name: describeReservedElasticsearchInstanceOfferings
methods.description: Describes offerings for reserved Elasticsearch instances.

methods.name: dissociatePackage
methods.description: Dissociates a package from a domain.

methods.name: getPackageVersionHistory
methods.description: Gets the version history of a package.

methods.name: getUpgradeHistory
methods.description: Retrieves upgrade history for a domain.

methods.name: getUpgradeStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a domain upgrade.

methods.name: listDomainsForPackage
methods.description: Lists domains associated with a package.

methods.name: listVpcEndpointsForDomain
methods.description: Lists VPC endpoints for a domain.

methods.name: purchaseReservedElasticsearchInstanceOffering
methods.description: Purchases a reserved Elasticsearch instance offering.

methods.name: rejectInboundCrossClusterSearchConnection
methods.description: Rejects an inbound cross-cluster search connection.

methods.name: updateElasticsearchDomainConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a domain.
